launches.title: REV1 - Automating engineering drawings for Mechanical Engineers
launches.tagline: It's time for Mechanical Engineers to automate their workflows
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** REV1 turns 3D CAD models into manufacturing-ready 2D drawings in minutes instead of hours.

[**https://youtu.be/rlGxyHiPOW4**](https://youtu.be/rlGxyHiPOW4)

**The Problem:**

Every manufactured part – whether it's for aerospace, robotics, medical devices, or consumer electronics – needs a 2D engineering drawing that defines the manufacturing specs to ensure the part functions as designed. Mechanical engineers spend **over 25% of their time** creating these drawings manually. It's tedious, error-prone, and unavoidable. It's also deeply technical – the standard that governs tolerancing is **over 300 pages of rules**.

The real cost isn't just time – it's innovation. Engineers should be designing the next iteration and solving hard problems, not manually specifying tolerances.

**Our Solution:**

REV1 automates drawing creation. Start with a 3D CAD file, specify your design intent, and we generate a fully annotated drawing with proper GD&T. Review and edit in our native interface before sending to manufacturers. All that while staying synced with your source files in your PLM system.

**Communicate your design intent in 3D:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97401&key=user_uploads/2150068/bd8b20b4-1f27-48fa-8c11-9d4c803c4a63)

**Drawing generation in minutes instead of hours:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97401&key=user_uploads/2150068/d425df48-2074-4e7e-a29f-8515dd864f62)

**Who are we**

* **Alex** – Mechanical engineer who shipped products at scale at Tesla and Apple (worked on Cybertruck, Robotaxi and iPhone 17 lineup). Lived this problem for years.
* **Louis** – Software engineer; solo built Tesla's global Supercharger & Robotaxi planning platform. Studied mechanical engineering in school; published ML researcher

**Who it's for**

Mechanical engineering teams at hardware companies – especially those designing parts that need detailed manufacturing specs. Think robotics, aerospace, automotive, medical devices, and consumer electronics.

**Our ask**

* Intros to mechanical engineering leads or hardware founders who feel this pain
* If you're an ME, we'd love your feedback on the product
* Spread the word to anyone building physical products
